lm_enriched_caption: An instrumental hard rock track driven by an expressive lead electric guitar with a thick, saturated distortion tone rich with sustain and feedback. The piece opens with a soulful, melodic guitar solo featuring prominent string bends and vibrato over atmospheric chords. A full band enters establishing a steady mid-tempo groove with clean bass and crisp drums. The arrangement builds into powerful sections where layered guitars play harmonized riffs that function like vocal lines, punctuated by aggressive staccato phrases. The centerpiece is an extended, virtuosic guitar solo filled with rapid-fire licks, soaring bends, whammy bar dives, and intricate runs across the fretboard, showcasing a strong blues-rock influence before concluding on a sustained chord progression accompanied by the sound of audience applause fading out.
brief_drift: The largest of the set: a power ballad came back as a lead-guitar showcase with a virtuoso solo, and the LM asked for audience applause fading out at the end. The loop is cut from 42-100s of the render, so the ending is not in it; a spectral-flatness check of the render found no sustained noise-like (applause) passage either. Whether the rest still reads as Ember is a listening call; lm_negative_prompt "guitar solo, audience applause, live recording" is the obvious next try.
